title: Coefficient problems of Starlike Functions Related to a Balloon-Shaped Domain
summary: Recent advances in image and signal processing have drawn on geometric function theory, particularly coefficient estimate problems. Motivated by their significance, we introduce a class of starlike functions related to a balloon-shaped domain \[ \mathcal{S}^*_{\mathcal{B}}= \left\{ f \in \mathcal{A} : \frac{z f'(z)}{f(z)} \prec \frac{1}{1-\log(1+z)} := B(z); \; z \in \mathbb{D} \right\}, \] where $B(z)$ maps the unit disk $\mathbb{D}$ onto a balloon-shaped domain.
